beats.headline: Ten of them, from a Nightgaunt
beats.text: Deckmaster number seven of ten is a Nightgaunt, and Carl's cloak aggravates it so much that it ignores its own deck to try spells on him until Jola slams it to the ground and kills it. It drops thirty cards. Eighteen are totems, one a legendary Demon Queen and the rest Quench Moths, which gain speed and constitution when touching a light. Ten are consumable snare cards, all called Lamp: each paralyses a totem for ten seconds and makes it glow brightly. Played, snares and moths would have made a hard fight. Carl and Donut take the token and all the cards they can, and leave the totems.

beats.headline: Stuck in her hand
beats.text: In a collapsing building, with demons coming from both sides and Imani holding them off where she is trapped with Tran, Donut reads out her hand: Alpha Carl, Shi Maria, the Golden Combo and the Lamp snare. Her Hole spell is loaded into her staff totem, and the staff is not in her hand. She cannot discard for a bit. Carl tells her to discard when she can, especially the snares, and play everything else until the staff comes up.
